title: Vibe Coding — Spec discovery (unclear requirements)
description: Requirement-quality workflow for tasks where the spec is not yet locked: ingest (read sources + lock scope), then clarify until AC/scope are decision-ready and hand off. Does not include PLAN.md or Execute.

steps.title: Ingest spec
steps.notes: Research and scope only — no PLAN.md. Output: .vibe/research/<task-id>.md

steps.title: Clarify & hand off
steps.notes: Same phase as phase.spec-clarity: clarify (ingest.read-sources) then handoff. Quality bar: AC, scope boundaries, assumptions, and open questions are explicit in .vibe/research/<task-id>.md. When ready, add "Spec ready for PLAN" and approve. Use phase.spec.brainstorm only if exploration is needed before AC exist. Then start planning with the same task_id and an execution router.
